comment: W-DS G-7 token lint — stylelint half (VISUAL-QA-CHECKLIST.md §4).
ERROR MODE since Phase 6 (ratchet): the rules below stay severity:warning
so the census of grandfathered debt stays visible, but `npm run lint:css`
runs with --max-warnings 929 (the Phase 6 frozen count) — any INCREASE
fails the build (exit 1). Paying debt down ratchets the number lower;
it may never rise. What is checked here:
R-SPACE-1 no raw length literals in spacing properties;
R-SURF-2 border-radius only via the radius token map / 50% / 0 / 999px;
R-SURF-3 box-shadow only via --u-shadow-* tokens / none;
R-TYPE-1 font-size only via the type ramp tokens (raw sizes warn — census).
The context-aware G-7 checks (Arabic tracking pairing, globals.css selector trend,
primitive-class census, per-file ratchets) live in scripts/token-lint.mjs —
run both: npm run lint:css && npm run lint:tokens -- --enforce \
